Severe Weather Warning for Snowy Mountains
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 80 to 90 km/h with peak gusts up to 110 km/h are possible over alpine areas above 1900 metres from Saturday morning, easing by the evening. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top Station.

warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for North East, West and South Gippsland, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 70 km/h with peak gusts of around 100 km/h are possible over the eastern ranges above 1200 metres from Saturday morning, easing by the evening. Locations which may be affected include Falls Creek, Mt Hotham and Mt Buller.

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Northern Goldfields and Upper Flinders, Central Highlands and Coalfields, Central West, Maranoa and Warrego
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Pentland, Aramac, Elgin Downs, Aberfoyle, Torrens Creek and Natal Downs. Heavy to locally intense rainfall has been reported east of Charleville this afternoon. 65 mm recorded at Joylands in the 3 hours to 7:31pm. 59 mm recorded at South Lesdale in the 3 hours to 5:30 pm.

warnings.title: Cancellation of Severe Thunderstorm Warning for North West Pastoral, North East Pastoral
warnings.desc: This warning is now cancelled. Thunderstorms are likely to persist for the next couple of hours but are no longer expected to be severe.
